thesis: L2 cap (4/4) reached at 10:11 with only one filled trade: three limit entries (TSLA short 09:39, TSLA long 10:00, MSTR short 10:09) expired unfilled after the 120 s entry timeout and still count toward the L2 cap. Two were priced at or just through the touch and the book moved away. No screened playbooks, so no L0/L1 entries are possible for the rest of the day. Lesson for execution: when using limit entries for L2, price them marketable (through the bid/ask by a tick or two) or use market orders, since every unfilled attempt burns a scarce L2 slot. Owner: consider whether expired-unfilled entries should count against the L2 cap.
